doc: Test and shot fixture for the document reader (M4-A2P-080): not a game record. The words are plain stand-in lines in the ledgers' register so the layout shows real wrapping; the game's records are Narrative's (game/data/lore/records.json).

lines: First lamp, the east stair: lit by Abrel, oil from the north press.
Second lamp, the landing: lit by Sorrow-of-Tide, wick of reed.
Third lamp, the long hall: lit by the founders together, the night the water stood still.
Fourth lamp, the cistern door: lit, and the name scraped away.
Fifth lamp, the low arch: lit by Mirrin, who signs with a hooked stroke.
Cantor of the first chair: Ottel, of the reed-houses.
Cantor of the second chair: one who signs with a hooked stroke.
Cantor of the third chair: vacant since the flood year.
Cantor of the fourth chair: Abrel, oil-presser, admitted late.
Kept in a careful hand: the lamps will be lit again when the water moves.
Below it, crossed through: not by us.
In the corner, a hooked stroke and nothing else.
Three notches: the tide came twice and did not go.
A circle with a line through it: do not ring the bell.
A small fish, and her letter beside it.
